main_text.p: medium : hinc resilies: & ad aliam mox ac aliam divertes te palæstram,non dissimili intentione: Nulla vita vivacior, quam varia: quæ irritato leviter appetitu, mox delibat aliud, nec satietate, sed aviditate pascitur. Cur inchoanti lex est ut perficiat? Quis hoc decernit? Atra bilis: Ut habeat nempe quas Fastidio mactet victimas, & Pertinaciæ, & Desperationi: ut sensim nos astringat & exsiccet: & amandet extra rerum Universitatem, quidquid fluidum, solutum, liberale: Non feremus: dentibus & unguibus rescindimus importunum decretum: Loquere: Te audimus, ô Vigor, tibi paremus:
& ultra finem est, qui mediis appropinquat alacriter: Larga regula; Sed

page.notes: Running head and page number printed at top of page. The first line begins a fragment continuing from the previous page. The last line of text is set flush right ("la; Sed"), and the italic line "habet," is indented and stands as a line of its own within the quotation. Left-edge show-through and the library stamp/credit at the foot are omitted.
